description_expanded: Sandcastle Dunes - Vacation Rental in Watersound with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Rooftop Patio - Fireplace - Gated Community - Community Pool - 5-Minute Walk to Beach - 4 Included Bikes More About Sandcastle Dunes: Sandcastle Dunes is a luxury vacation rental in Watersound, a beautiful gated neighborhood that offers a community pool. Between the main house and carriage house, this property features six bedrooms and seven bathrooms sleeping a total of 12 guests. Take a five minute scenic stroll to the beach or relax by the pool!   Welcome to Sandcastle Dunes overlooking a serene pond! This stunning property offers a combination of architectural elegance, modern amenities, and breathtaking views, ensuring a truly remarkable getaway. As you enter, you'll be captivated by the architectural details that adorn the living room. Beams accentuate the high ceilings, while the wood floors add warmth and character. The shiplap wainscoting provides a touch of coastal charm, creating a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. Nestled in one corner, a fireplace beckons you to cozy up on cool evenings. The living room opens up to a wrap-around deck, offering panoramic views of the picturesque pond. The kitchen is a gourmet's delight, boasting top-of-the-line appliances and gorgeous countertops that cater to your culinary desires. The centerpiece is a 6-burner gas stove, perfect for preparing exquisite meals. Additionally, a beverage cooler and ice maker ensure your drinks are always chilled to perfection. The kitchen also features bar seating for six, allowing for casual dining and socializing while enjoying the beautiful surroundings. Nearby a formal dining room is available with seating for eight. A primary king suite resides on the first floor for those that prefer not to use the stairs. It boasts a stunning claw-foot tub, shower, water closet, and true dual vanities.  Make your way to the second floor, where you'll find a living room designed for relaxation and entertainment. Three comfortable couches are arranged around a TV and Blu-ray player, providing an ideal setting for movie nights or catching up on your favorite shows. The living room also grants access to a wrap-around balcony, where you can savor the tranquil pond views while enjoying fresh air and wildlife. Three lovely bedrooms are offered on the second floor, each with its own private bathroom. In addition, there is also a bunk nook with a twin daybed with twin trundle. On the third floor, a landing awaits, featuring additional couches where you can unwind and enjoy some quiet moments. Venture up a spiral staircase, and you'll reach the crown jewel of Sandcastle Dunes—a rooftop patio. From this vantage point, you'll be treated to breathtaking panoramic views of the pond and the surrounding landscape. Whether you're sipping a morning coffee or stargazing in the evening, this rooftop oasis is the perfect spot for relaxation and reflection. If additional sleeping accommodations are required, the carriage house features a king bed, private bathroom, and kitchenette.  Overall, Sandcastle Dunes offers a harmonious blend of architectural beauty, modern amenities, and serene pond views. It's a haven where you can immerse yourself in luxurious comfort while enjoying the tranquility of nature. Whether you're curled up by the fireplace, entertaining on the wrap-around deck, or taking in the views from the rooftop patio, it promises an unforgettable escape! Watersound is a beautiful private community surrounded by nature. With winding trails and multiple beach access points, exploring will be a must! Your rendezvous awaits! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Additional Arrangements: Twin Daybed with Twin Trundle THIRD FLOOR Additional Arrangements: Queen Bed GUEST HOUSE Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
